items.title: Jackie McLean — Smithsonian Jazz Oral History
items.q: it was through going around to jam sessions and things that I met him and heard him play and played with him.

ctx.x: Yeah. Played good, and it was through going around to jam sessions and things that I met him and heard him play and played with him. But I was real young compared to many of those guys.
What was your interaction with Bud as it unfolded? Did you go over there frequently?
